title: Cancellation Notice, Reschedules, Late Arrivals and No-Shows — Appointment Series
content:
Patient financial policy: how Piedmont Motion classifies a cancelled, moved, late or missed appointment on an Appointment Series.

**1. When changes are recorded.** Appointments are cancelled, rescheduled or recorded as missed only on a series in booked, active or paused status, as shown on the series record.

**2. Notice.** Notice is the whole hours between the moment the cancellation reached the clinic and the appointment start. A voicemail is timed by its timestamp where the format times voicemail by its timestamp. A portal cancellation is accepted only where portal cancellation is allowed for the format and no later than the format's portal cancellation cutoff before the start.

**3. Late cancellation.** A cancellation with notice below the format's minimum notice is a late cancellation. A cancellation by the clinic (recorded with the reason "clinic cancelled") is never a late cancellation, and a replacement is offered within the format's clinic-cancellation rebooking period in calendar days.

**4. Reschedules.** A rescheduled appointment counts as a reschedule, not a cancellation. No more than the format's maximum reschedules are allowed on a series, counted over the whole life of the series, and beyond that a move is a cancellation.

**5. Late arrival.** A patient arriving within the format's grace period is seen, for the remaining slot time where the format provides for a shortened visit. A later arrival is recorded as the format specifies — as a no-show or as a late cancellation.

**6. No-show.** A booked appointment with no arrival and no cancellation is a no-show.

**Worked cases (hypothetical times).**

| Situation | Notice or lateness | Format | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| Voicemail left Monday 19:30 for a Wednesday 10:00 appointment | 38 whole hours | Standard 45-Minute Visit Series (24 hours) | not a late cancellation |
| Same voicemail | 38 whole hours | Specialty One-on-One Visit Series (48 hours) | late cancellation |
| Call received exactly 24 hours before the start | 24 hours | Standard 45-Minute Visit Series (24 hours) | not below the minimum: not a late cancellation |
| Call received 23 hours before the start | 23 hours | Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | late cancellation |
| Clinic cancels 2 hours before the start | 2 hours | any format | never a late cancellation; replacement offered |
| Fifth move of an appointment | — | Aquatic Therapy Visit Series (4 reschedules) | a cancellation, not a reschedule |
| Arrival 20 minutes after the start | 20 minutes | Extended 60-Minute Visit Series (15-minute grace) | recorded as a late cancellation |
| No arrival, no call | — | any format | no-show |
